categories.name: Occupational safety
categories.definition: Worker safety, training, PPE and hazards on sites; excludes machinery product certification and hazardous-substance-specific duties.

categories.name: Machinery and work equipment
categories.definition: Equipment inspection, maintenance and machine operational safety; excludes general PPE and product market certification.

categories.name: Chemicals and hazardous substances
categories.definition: Chemical exposure, safety data sheets, substance storage and handling; road carriage belongs to dangerous goods.

categories.name: Fire and explosion protection
categories.definition: Fire prevention, explosive atmospheres, evacuation fire controls; excludes general structural design.

categories.name: Air emissions
categories.definition: Air pollutants, emissions measurement and stack monitoring; greenhouse-gas accounting belongs to climate.

categories.name: Waste and circular economy
categories.definition: Waste registers, disposal, recycling and material recovery; excludes water discharge.

categories.name: Water and wastewater
categories.definition: Water abstraction, wastewater discharge, groundwater and water permits; excludes soil remediation.

categories.name: Soil and contaminated land
categories.definition: Contaminated-site investigation, excavated soil contamination and remediation; excludes ordinary geotechnical design.

categories.name: Nature and biodiversity
categories.definition: Protected species, habitats and ecological restrictions; excludes landscape architectural design.

categories.name: Noise and vibration
categories.definition: Environmental noise/vibration limits and measurement; occupational chemical exposure is separate.

categories.name: Energy efficiency
categories.definition: Energy consumption, energy audits and efficiency reporting; excludes renewable generation permits and climate inventories.

categories.name: Climate and carbon accounting
categories.definition: Greenhouse-gas inventories, carbon emissions accounting and emissions trading; excludes local pollutant monitoring.

categories.name: Renewable energy
categories.definition: Renewable generation assets and their connection/operating requirements; energy consumption audits are separate.

categories.name: Building permits and public building law
categories.definition: Building authorisation, use approval and local public building requirements; excludes procurement tender rules.

categories.name: Structural and geotechnical design
categories.definition: Load-bearing calculations, structural stability, foundations and soil-bearing design; excludes product market declarations.

categories.name: Construction product conformity
categories.definition: Market conformity, declarations of performance and marking of construction products; excludes project-specific load calculations.

categories.name: Public procurement and tenders
categories.definition: Public tender procedures, bidder eligibility, award criteria and procurement challenges; private supplier audits are separate.

categories.name: Contracts and liability
categories.definition: Commercial construction contract terms, defects, claims and civil liability; excludes insurance coverage administration.

categories.name: Supply-chain due diligence
categories.definition: Supplier human-rights and environmental due diligence, sourcing controls and remediation; excludes public tender procedure.

categories.name: Road transport and fleets
categories.definition: Commercial vehicle operating, driver, roadworthiness and logistics duties; hazardous loads belong to dangerous goods.

categories.name: Dangerous-goods transport
categories.definition: Classification, packaging, documentation and safe carriage of dangerous goods in transport.

categories.name: Employment and working time
categories.definition: Employment conditions, working hours, leave and employee records; excludes works council participation.

categories.name: Works council and participation
categories.definition: Works council consultation, participation rights and employee representation.

categories.name: Data protection and privacy
categories.definition: Personal-data processing, lawful purpose, access, retention and data-subject rights; excludes network technical hardening alone.

categories.name: Cybersecurity
categories.definition: Network/system security, vulnerability handling and technical cyber-incident controls; personal-data law is separate.

categories.name: Corporate governance and compliance
categories.definition: Governance, anti-bribery, conflicts of interest and whistleblowing controls; excludes bookkeeping standards.

categories.name: Financial accounting and reporting
categories.definition: Bookkeeping, financial statements, recognition and financial disclosure; excludes tax return obligations.

categories.name: Tax and customs
categories.definition: Tax returns, tax records, VAT and customs declarations; excludes non-tax financial statement preparation.

categories.name: Insurance
categories.definition: Insurance policies, coverage, claims notification and insured-risk records; contractual liability itself is separate.

categories.name: ESG and sustainability reporting
categories.definition: Company-level sustainability disclosure covering environmental, social and governance indicators; single energy audits/carbon calculations use their specific categories.
